question: By what numerical and originary designation is this chapter identified as emerging from Candradvīpa?
premises: The chapter is said to have emerged from Candradvīpa.
It is counted as the fifth in sequence.
The term paṭala designates it as a chapter of the text.
inference: This is the fifth chapter, said to have emerged from Candradvīpa.
uncertainties: The textual significance of Candradvīpa as a source is not explained here.
plain_english: The fifth chapter, which emerged from Candradvīpa, is here set forth.
